page.layout: One page of text in a single main column; marginal notes in the left margin (three blocks of small notes: "Tom. I. Zwinglii oper. pag. 120.", "Chronicon Bullingeri.", "Exstat To. I. oper Zwinglii pag. 124."). Running head at top with page number 116 and the title "Annus MDXXII." Digitiser's watermark at bottom right is excluded.

main_text.p: patiantur. Scripsit ibidem suo & Fratrum nonnullorum nomine supplicationem ad R. D. Hugonem Episcopum Constantiensem: quâ illum rogant: ne se induci patiatur, ut quicquam in praeiudicium Evangelii promulget: neve scortationis scandalum ultrà ferat, sed presbyteris uxores ducere permittat, aut saltem ad eorum nuptias conniveat.Chronicon Bullingeri. Subscripserunt, M. Balthasar Trachselus, Pastor in Ardsuitiae: M. Georgius Calybeus, pastor VVimigensis: M. VVernerus Steiner, Pastor ex Tugio: M. Leo Judae, Pastor Eremi, sed designatus pastor D. Petri Tiguri: M. Erasmus Schmid, Canonicus Tigurinus: Simon Stumpfius, praedicator in Honeck: Jodocus Kilchmeier Canonicus Lucernensis: Huldricus Pistoris, pastor in Ufer: Caspar Megander, Nosocomii Tigurini, Joannes Faber, & Huldrichus Zwinglius, summi templi Tigurini pastores.

Idem Zwinglius vicesimâ secundâ Augusti huius anni ad Paraenesin Episcopi Constantiensis ad senatum Praepositurae Tigurinae (Capitulum vocant) missam, respondit Apologetico, quem Archetelem nuncupavit, hoc est, principium & finem, idque ideo, quod speraret initium & finem, hoc est, summam controversiae, inter ipsos hoc moderato scripto compositum iri. Monet eo libro Episcopum, ne aurem accommodet veri-
Exstat To. I. oper Zwinglii pag. 124.

page.notes: Marginal notes in the left margin were transcribed as foot lines; the left margin notes are small and partly blurred. Some words at the right edge of the text are slightly uncertain (e.g. "Frattum", "Archetelem"). The title "Annus MDXXII." is set in Roman numerals as printed in the running head.
